keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Zakaria Aboukhlal (Torino) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Antonio Raimondo (Frosinone).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Frosinone. Daniel Bîrligea replaces Antonio Raimondo because of an injury.
Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
First Half ends, Frosinone 0, Torino 0.
Substitution, Torino. Emirhan Ilkhan replaces Gvidas Gineitis.
Substitution, Torino. Nathan Patterson replaces Zakaria Aboukhlal.
Second Half begins Frosinone 0, Torino 0.
Goal! Frosinone 1, Torino 0. Farès Ghedjemis (Frosinone) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Giorgi Kvernadze following a corner.
Patrizio Masini (Frosinone) is shown the yellow card.
Saúl Coco (Torino) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Frosinone. Luis Hasa replaces Romano Schmid.
Substitution, Frosinone. Matteo Cichella replaces Patrizio Masini.
Substitution, Torino. Duván Zapata replaces Ché Adams.
Substitution, Torino. Gaetano Oristanio replaces Rafik Belghali because of an injury.
Substitution, Frosinone. Alessio Zerbin replaces Giorgi Kvernadze.
Substitution, Frosinone. Wisdom Amey replaces Enzo Tchato.
Substitution, Torino. Sandro Kulenovic replaces Giovanni Simeone.
